findings.distinction: Set uncertainty,choice probability,accuracy and confidence are distinct.
findings.blockedClaim: Interval radius or reason-dice probability is a calibrated belief posterior.
findings.reopen: A new consumer needs fusion,trust,correlation or probability calibration.

findings.distinction: Vivid sensory readout differs from access,truth,confidence and subjective experience.
findings.blockedClaim: Clear recall establishes accuracy or universal imagery semantics.
findings.reopen: Natural encoding,new modalities or downstream behavior requires independent evidence.

findings.distinction: Psychological scalar sufficiency survives failure of other projections and body-only reduction.
findings.blockedClaim: The affect vector is proven necessary or its coordinates can be globally retired.
findings.reopen: An independently motivated consumer discriminates what the retained scalar discards.

findings.distinction: Episode-local causal inference differs from cross-episode expectation.
findings.blockedClaim: One revised explanation establishes learned likelihoods or general causal identification.
findings.reopen: New hypotheses,co-occurring causes,empirical likelihoods or autonomous diagnosis are required.

findings.distinction: A terminal update demonstrates retained state,not a subsequent consumer effect.
findings.blockedClaim: Primary terminal-report tests already qualified the later interference appraisal.
findings.reopen: Broader replay/consumer claims require actual post-update probes with exact source lineage.
